easy.def: To sing with high and low jumps.
examples: He likes to yodel.
The man yodeled on the hill.
She can yodel high.

more.def: To sing by switching quickly between a low voice and a very high voice.
examples: The man yodeled across the mountain valley.
He can yodel so loud that his voice echoes.
She yodeled a song while hiking in the mountains.

easy.def: Slow stretching and calm breathing exercises.
examples: We did yoga.
Yoga makes me calm.
A yoga class.

more.def: A set of slow stretches, poses and breathing exercises that help your body and mind feel calm and strong.
examples: We did yoga in gym class and stretched like cats.
Yoga helps you feel calm and bend easily.
My mom goes to a yoga class on Tuesdays.

easy.def: A creamy food made from milk.
examples: I eat yogurt for breakfast.
The yogurt has fruit in it.
She likes strawberry yogurt.

more.def: A thick, creamy food made from milk that has become slightly sour, often eaten with fruit or sweet things.
examples: I like to eat strawberry yogurt with granola for breakfast.
Yogurt is made from milk by adding helpful bacteria.
Mom blended yogurt, bananas and berries into a smoothie.

easy.def: The yellow part of an egg.
examples: The yolk is yellow.
I ate the yolk.
Break the yolk.

more.def: The yellow part in the center of an egg.
examples: I mixed the egg yolk in the batter.
The yolk is yellow and round.
A baby bird grows from the egg's yolk.
Look at that tree yonder.
The house is yonder.
He pointed yonder.

more.def: An old word for over there, at a distance.
examples: Look at the barn yonder.
The river flows yonder in the valley.
He pointed yonder at the mountains.

easy.def: A word for the person who is being talked to.
examples: Can you help me?
I made this for you.
Do you like pizza?

more.def: A word used for the person or people being spoken or written to.
examples: Thank you for coming to my birthday party.
If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
Coach said you all did a great job today.
A puppy is a young dog.
The young bird can not fly yet.
My sister is too young for school.

more.def: Having lived or existed for only a short time.
examples: The young tree was only as tall as my knee.
Young children need plenty of sleep.
The team is young, but it is improving fast.
The youngster waved hello.
Each youngster got a hat.
A youngster ran up to us.

more.def: A young person or child, especially one who is still growing up.
examples: Every youngster at the camp got a turn on the swing.
The coach was proud of the youngsters on her team.
A youngster can learn to ride a bike in just a few days.

easy.def: A word that shows something belongs to you.
examples: Is this your cup?
Wash your hands.
I like your shirt.

more.def: A word used to show that something belongs to the person or people being spoken to.
examples: Please put your backpacks on the hooks by the door.
Your science project looks amazing.
What is your favorite animal at the zoo?

easy.def: A word for something that belongs to you.
examples: Is this yours?
The red hat is yours.
Mine is big, yours is small.

more.def: A word used for something that belongs to the person or people you are speaking to.
examples: I found a blue pencil, and I think it is yours.
My backpack is green, and yours is red.
The seat by the window is yours if you want it.
Did you make it yourself?
Pour yourself some milk.
Be yourself.

more.def: A word used for the person you are talking to, when they do something to themselves or without help.
examples: Did you build this fort all by yourself?
Be careful not to hurt yourself on the ice.
You can see for yourself how big the tree is.

easy.def: The time when you are young.
examples: In his youth he lived on a farm.
Youth is a happy time.
She spent her youth by the sea.

more.def: The part of your life when you are young.
examples: In his youth, he lived on a farm.
Grandma tells stories about her youth.
She spent her youth in a small town.
The youth of our town worked together.
Youth play on the team.
The club is for youth.
The town's youth cleaned the beach.
A club for the youth meets on Fridays.
Today's youth use computers every day.
A youthful face.
She is youthful.
Youthful energy.

more.def: Looking, feeling or acting young and full of energy.
examples: Grandma has a youthful smile and loves to dance.
The youthful team ran with great energy.
He is youthful for his age.

easy.def: To make a long, loud cry.
examples: The cat yowled.
The dog yowled at the moon.
He yowled in pain.

more.def: To make a long, loud, sad cry, as a cat or dog does.
examples: The cat yowled outside the window all night.
The puppy yowled when it was left alone.
We heard a fox yowl in the dark.
